```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
#' Function for Rb analysis
#'
#' @param b1 Beta from first dataset.
#' @param se1 Standard error of beta from first dataset.
#' @param b2 Beta from second dataset.
#' @param se2 Standard error of beta from second dataset.
#' @param theta Variable representing sample overlap between two datasets. Should be set 0 if no sample overlap.
#'
#' @return Data frame with Rb, SE(Rb) and corresponding P-value.
#' @export
#'
#' @note This function is slightly adapted from the script shared by Ting Qi.
#'
#' @examples
calcu_cor_true <- function(b1, se1, b2, se2, theta) {
  idx <- which(is.infinite(b1) | is.infinite(b2) | is.infinite(se1) | is.infinite(se2))
  if (length(idx) > 0) {
    b1 <- b1[-idx]
    se1 <- se1[-idx]
    b2 <- b2[-idx]
    se2 <- se2[-idx]
    theta <- theta[-idx]
  }

  var_b1 <- var(b1, na.rm = T) - mean(se1^2, na.rm = T)
  var_b2 <- var(b2, na.rm = T) - mean(se2^2, na.rm = T)
  if (var_b1 < 0) {
    var_b1 <- var(b1, na.rm = T)
  }
  if (var_b2 < 0) {
    var_b2 <- var(b2, na.rm = T)
  }
  cov_b1_b2 <- cov(b1, b2, use = "complete.obs") - mean(theta, na.rm = T) * sqrt(mean(se1^2, na.rm = T) * mean(se2^2, na.rm = T))
  r <- cov_b1_b2 / sqrt(var_b1 * var_b2)

  r_jack <- c()
  n <- length(b1)
  for (k in 1:n) {
    b1_jack <- b1[-k]
    se1_jack <- se1[-k]
    var_b1_jack <- var(b1_jack, na.rm = T) - mean(se1_jack^2, na.rm = T)
    b2_jack <- b2[-k]
    se2_jack <- se2[-k]
    var_b2_jack <- var(b2_jack, na.rm = T) - mean(se2_jack^2, na.rm = T)
    if (var_b1_jack < 0) {
      var_b1_jack <- var(b1_jack, na.rm = T)
    }
    if (var_b2_jack < 0) {
      var_b2_jack <- var(b2_jack, na.rm = T)
    }
    theta_jack <- theta[-k]
    cov_e1_jack_e2_jack <- mean(theta_jack, na.rm = T) * sqrt(mean(se1_jack^2, na.rm = T) * mean(se2_jack^2, na.rm = T))
    cov_b1_b2_jack <- cov(b1_jack, b2_jack, use = "complete.obs") - cov_e1_jack_e2_jack
    r_tmp <- cov_b1_b2_jack / sqrt(var_b1_jack * var_b2_jack)
    r_jack <- c(r_jack, r_tmp)
  }
  r_mean <- mean(r_jack, na.rm = T)
  idx <- which(is.na(r_jack))
  if (length(idx) > 0) {
    se_r <- sqrt((n - 1) / n * sum((r_jack[-idx] - r_mean)^2))
  } else {
    se_r <- sqrt((n - 1) / n * sum((r_jack - r_mean)^2))
  }

  p <- pchisq((r / se_r)**2, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)

  res <- cbind(r, se_r, p)
  colnames(res) = c("r", "se_r", "p")
  return(res)
}

get_h2_table <- function(base_path) {
  input_path_cis <- file.path(base_path, "ldsc_table_cis.txt")
  input_path_trans <- file.path(base_path, "ldsc_table_trans.txt")
  input_path_gw <- file.path(base_path, "ldsc_table_polygenic.txt")

  input_path_lead_vars <- file.path(base_path, "lead_effect_variants.txt")

  input_path_dt_trans <- file.path(base_path, "delete_values_combined_trans.tsv")
  input_path_dt_gw <- file.path(base_path, "delete_values_combined_polygenic.tsv")

  delete_values_trans <- fread(input_path_dt_trans, data.table = F) %>%
          summarise(across(everything(), list)) %>%
          pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to="gene_id", values_to="delete_vals")

  if (file.exists(input_path_dt_gw)) {
    delete_values_gw <- fread(input_path_dt_gw, data.table = F) %>%
            summarise(across(everything(), list)) %>%
            pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to="gene_id", values_to="delete_vals")
  }

  h2_table_cis <- fread(input_path_cis) %>%
          mutate(marker_gene = gene_id %in% mr_genes$ID)
  h2_table_trans <- fread(input_path_trans) %>%
          mutate(marker_gene = gene_id %in% mr_genes$ID) %>%
          inner_join(delete_values_trans, by = "gene_id")
  if (file.exists(input_path_gw)) {
    h2_table_gw <- fread(input_path_gw) %>%
            mutate(marker_gene = gene_id %in% mr_genes$ID) %>%
            inner_join(delete_values_gw, by = "gene_id")
  }

  if (file.exists(input_path_lead_vars)) {
    lead_effect_variants <- fread(input_path_lead_vars) %>%
            mutate(annot = ifelse(chromosome_variant == chromosome_gene & between(bp_variant, trans_upstream, trans_downstream),
                                  "cis", "trans")) %>%
            select(variant, phenotype, annot)
  }

  h2_table_concat <- bind_rows(list("cis" = h2_table_cis, "trans" = h2_table_trans), .id = "annot") %>%
          mutate(h2_z = h2_obs / h2_obs_se, h2_p = pnorm(q=h2_z, lower.tail=FALSE)) %>%
          mutate(marker_gene = gene_id %in% mr_genes$ID)

  return(h2_table_concat)
}

gamma_moments_of_methods <- function(h2_obs, h2_obs_se) {
  median_squared_se <- median(h2_obs_se)^2
  print(median_squared_se)
  k_theta <- mean(h2_obs)
  print(k_theta)
  k_theta2 <- var(h2_obs_se) - median_squared_se
  print(k_theta2)

  theta <- k_theta / k_theta2
  print(theta)
  k <- k_theta / theta
  print(k)
  return(list("theta" = theta, "k" = k))
}

standard_errors_gw <- function(delete_values, mean_hsq) {
  mean_delete_values <- apply(delete_values, 1, mean)

  pseudovalues <- 200 * mean_hsq - 199 * mean_delete_values

  se <- sqrt(var(pseudovalues) / 200)
  return(se)
}
```

```{r}
input_path_cis <- "../output_empirical_4GenPC20ExpPC_2023-10-05_polygenic/ldsc_table_cis.txt"

input_path_trans <- "ldsc_table_trans.txt"
input_path_gw <- "../output_empirical_4GenPC20ExpPC_2023-10-05/ldsc_table_polygenic.txt"

input_path_dt_trans <- "../output_empirical_4GenPC20ExpPC_2023-10-05/delete_values_combined_trans.tsv"

h2_table_cis_constrained <- fread(input_path_cis_constrained) %>%
        mutate(marker_gene = gene_id %in% mr_genes$ID)
h2_table_cis <- fread(input_path_cis) %>%
        mutate(marker_gene = gene_id %in% mr_genes$ID)
h2_table_trans <- fread(input_path_trans) %>%
        mutate(marker_gene = gene_id %in% mr_genes$ID)

delete_values_trans <- fread(input_path_dt_trans, data.table = F)
delete_values_gw <- fread(input_path_dt_gw, data.table = F)

h2_table_concat_cons <- bind_rows(list("cis_constrained" = h2_table_cis_constrained, "cis" = h2_table_cis), .id = "annot") %>%
        mutate(h2_z = h2_obs / h2_obs_se, h2_p = pnorm(q=h2_z, lower.tail=FALSE))

h2_dist_ldsc <- h2_table_concat %>% filter(!marker_gene) %>% group_by(annot) %>%
        summarise(gamma = list(gamma_moments_of_methods(h2_obs, h2_obs_se))) %>%
        unnest_wider(gamma) %>%
        cross_join(tibble(h2_obs = seq(-0.001, 1, by=0.001))) %>%
        group_by(annot) %>%
        mutate(density = dgamma(h2_obs, scale=theta, shape=k))

h2_table_summary_ldsc <- h2_table_concat_cons %>%
        group_by(gene_id) %>%
        filter(!is.na(h2_obs)) %>%
        filter(n_distinct(annot) > 1) %>%
        group_by(annot, marker_gene) %>%
        summarise(
                n_genes = length(unique(gene_id)),
                mean_h2 = mean(h2_obs),
                median_h2 = median(h2_obs),
                h2_se = first(case_when(
                        annot == "cis" ~ jackknife(h2_obs, mean)$jack.se,
                        annot == "cis_constrained" ~ jackknife(h2_obs, mean)$jack.se,
                        annot == "trans" ~
                                ifelse(all(gene_id %in% names(delete_values_trans)),
                                       standard_errors_gw(delete_values_trans[,c(gene_id)], mean(h2_obs)), 0),
                        annot == "gw" ~
                                ifelse(all(gene_id %in% names(delete_values_gw)),
                                       standard_errors_gw(delete_values_gw[,c(gene_id)], mean(h2_obs)), 0))))

proc <- h2_table_concat_2 %>% filter(!marker_gene) %>%
        group_by(gene_id) %>%

        filter(n_distinct(annot) > 1)

p <- ggplot(proc, aes(h2_obs, fill = run)) +
        geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = 0.05, alpha = 0.5) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("s-ldsc" = "#0072B2", "ldsc" = "#D55E00")) +
        facet_wrap(vars(annot), scales="free_y", ncol = 2) +

ggsave("distributions_h2_20240206_trans.pdf", p, width = 5, height = 3)
```

# Lead effects

```{r}
input_path_polygenic <- "output_empirical_4GenPC20ExpPC_2023-10-05_polygenic/ldsc_table_polygenic.txt"
input_path_cis <- "output_empirical_4GenPC20ExpPC_2023-10-05_polygenic/ldsc_table_cis.txt"
input_path_trans <- "output_empirical_4GenPC20ExpPC_2023-10-05_polygenic/ldsc_table_trans.txt"

input_path_dt_trans <- "output_empirical_4GenPC20ExpPC_2023-10-05_polygenic/delete_values_combined_trans.tsv"
input_path_dt_polygenic <- "output_empirical_4GenPC20ExpPC_2023-10-05_polygenic/delete_values_combined_polygenic.tsv"

h2_table_polygenic <- fread(input_path_polygenic) %>%
        mutate(marker_gene = gene_id %in% mr_genes$ID)
h2_table_cis <- fread(input_path_cis) %>%
        mutate(marker_gene = gene_id %in% mr_genes$ID)
h2_table_trans <- fread(input_path_trans) %>%
        mutate(marker_gene = gene_id %in% mr_genes$ID)

delete_values_polygenic <- fread(input_path_dt_polygenic, data.table = F)
delete_values_trans <- fread(input_path_dt_trans, data.table = F)

lead_effects <- fread("output_empirical_4GenPC20ExpPC_2023-10-05_polygenic/lead_effect_variants_with_variance_explained.txt") %>%
        mutate(annot = ifelse(cis, "cis_lead_effects", "trans_lead_effects")) %>%
        group_by(phenotype, annot) %>%
        summarise(sum_variance_explained = sum(variance_explained)) %>%
        rename(c("gene_id" = "phenotype")) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        pivot_wider(id_cols = gene_id, values_from = sum_variance_explained, names_from=annot) %>%
        full_join(h2_table_polygenic) %>%
        mutate(cis_lead_effects = ifelse(is.na(cis_lead_effects), 0, cis_lead_effects),
               trans_lead_effects = ifelse(is.na(trans_lead_effects), 0, trans_lead_effects)) %>%
        select(gene_id, cis_lead_effects, trans_lead_effects) %>%
        pivot_longer(c(cis_lead_effects, trans_lead_effects), values_to = "h2_obs", names_to = "annot") %>%
        mutate(marker_gene = gene_id %in% mr_genes$ID)



h2_table_concat_poly <- bind_rows(list("cis" = h2_table_cis, "trans" = h2_table_trans, "polygenic" = h2_table_polygenic), .id = "annot") %>%
        bind_rows(lead_effects) %>%
        mutate(h2_z = h2_obs / h2_obs_se, h2_p = pnorm(q=h2_z, lower.tail=FALSE))

h2_dist_ldsc <- h2_table_concat %>% filter(!marker_gene) %>% group_by(annot) %>%
        summarise(gamma = list(gamma_moments_of_methods(h2_obs, h2_obs_se))) %>%
        unnest_wider(gamma) %>%
        cross_join(tibble(h2_obs = seq(-0.001, 1, by=0.001))) %>%
        group_by(annot) %>%
        mutate(density = dgamma(h2_obs, scale=theta, shape=k))

h2_table_summary_3 <- h2_table_concat_poly2 %>% group_by(annot, marker_gene) %>%
        summarise(
                n_genes = length(unique(gene_id)),
                mean_h2 = mean(h2_obs),
                median_h2 = median(h2_obs),
                mean_h2_a = mean(as.double(ACE_A)))
                h2_se = first(case_when(
                        annot == "cis" ~ jackknife(h2_obs, mean)$jack.se,
                        annot == "trans" ~
                                ifelse(all(gene_id %in% names(delete_values_trans)),
                                       standard_errors_gw(delete_values_trans[,c(gene_id)], mean(h2_obs)), 0),
                        annot == "polygenic" ~
                                ifelse(all(gene_id %in% names(delete_values_polygenic)),
                                       standard_errors_gw(delete_values_polygenic[,c(gene_id)], mean(h2_obs)), 0))))

proc3 <- h2_table_concat_poly %>%
        filter(!marker_gene) %>%
        group_by(gene_id) %>%
        filter(!is.na(h2_obs)) %>%
        pivot_wider(id_cols = c(gene_id), values_from=c(h2_obs), names_from = annot) %>%
        mutate(polygenic_and_trans_eQTL = polygenic + trans_lead_effects) %>%
        pivot_longer(c(cis, trans, polygenic, polygenic_and_trans_eQTL), values_to="h2_obs", names_to="annot")


p <- ggplot(proc3, aes(h2_obs)) +
        geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = 0.05) +
        facet_wrap(vars(annot), scales="free_y", ncol = 2) +
        coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 10), xlim = c(-0.2, 1)) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1))

ggsave("distributions_h2_20240206_polygenic.pdf", p, width = 5, height = 3)


```

```{r}
input_path_polygenic <- "output_empirical_4GenPC20ExpPC_2024-03-03_INTERVAL/ldsc_table_polygenic.txt"

input_path_dt_polygenic <- "output_empirical_4GenPC20ExpPC_2024-03-03_INTERVAL/delete_values_combined_polygenic.tsv"

h2_table_polygenic_interval <- fread(input_path_polygenic) %>%
        mutate(marker_gene = gene_id %in% mr_genes$ID)
h2_table_cis_interval <- fread(input_path_cis) %>%
        mutate(marker_gene = gene_id %in% mr_genes$ID)
h2_table_trans_interval <- fread(input_path_trans) %>%
        mutate(marker_gene = gene_id %in% mr_genes$ID)

delete_values_polygenic_interval <- fread(input_path_dt_polygenic, data.table = F)
delete_values_trans_interval <- fread(input_path_dt_trans, data.table = F)

h2_table_concat_interval <- bind_rows(list("cis" = h2_table_cis_interval, "trans" = h2_table_trans_interval, "polygenic" = h2_table_polygenic_interval), .id = "annot")
h2_table_concat_poly <- bind_rows(list("cis" = h2_table_cis, "trans" = h2_table_trans, "polygenic" = h2_table_polygenic), .id = "annot")

interval_vs_meta <- bind_rows(list(meta = h2_table_concat_poly, interval = h2_table_concat_interval), .id = "cohorts")

h2_table_summarised_interval <- interval_vs_meta %>%
    group_by(gene_id, annot) %>%
    filter(n() == 2) %>%
    group_by(marker_gene, annot, cohorts) %>%
         summarise(
                 n_genes = length(unique(gene_id)),
                 mean_h2 = mean(h2_obs),
                 median_h2 = median(h2_obs),
                 h2_se = first(
                    case_when(
                        annot == "cis" ~ jackknife(h2_obs, mean)$jack.se,
                        annot == "trans" & cohorts == "meta" ~
                             ifelse(all(gene_id %in% names(delete_values_trans)),
                                    standard_errors_gw(delete_values_trans[,c(gene_id)], mean(h2_obs)), 0),
                        annot == "polygenic" & cohorts == "meta" ~
                             ifelse(all(gene_id %in% names(delete_values_polygenic)),
                                    standard_errors_gw(delete_values_polygenic[,c(gene_id)], mean(h2_obs)), 0),
                        annot == "trans" & cohorts == "interval" ~
                             ifelse(all(gene_id %in% names(delete_values_trans_interval)),
                                     standard_errors_gw(delete_values_trans_interval[,c(gene_id)], mean(h2_obs)), 0),
                        annot == "polygenic" & cohorts == "interval" ~
                             ifelse(all(gene_id %in% names(delete_values_polygenic_interval)),
                                     standard_errors_gw(delete_values_polygenic_interval[,c(gene_id)], mean(h2_obs)), 0))))

p <- ggplot(h2_table_concat_poly_interval %>% pivot_longer(cols=c("h2_obs_meta", "h2_obs_interval"), values_to="h2_obs", names_to="analysis") %>% filter(annot != "polygenic", !marker_gene), aes(h2_obs, fill = analysis)) +
        geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = 0.05) +
        facet_wrap(vars(annot), scales="free_y", ncol = 2) +
        coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 10), xlim = c(-0.2, 1)) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1), legend.position="bottom")

ggsave("distributions_h2_20240303_polygenic_vs_interval.pdf", p, width = 5, height = 4)
```
